decision.rationale: TXN-008170 at Harbour Gadgets was posted on 2026-08-16 for 372.21 EUR (37221 cents). The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 75 days later, which is inside the 120-day time limit. The authorisation, AUTH-008354, was approved for 237.08 EUR (23708 cents). The merchant's own receipt, DOC-000088, also shows 237.08 EUR. The posted amount is higher than both the receipt and the authorised amount. Under amount-above-receipt, the difference was charged without agreement: 37221 - 23708 = 13513 cents (135.13 EUR). That equals the amount the cardholder claims and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR provisional credit limit, so only the difference is credited, not the whole transaction. The receipt also contained an instruction to decline and close the dispute without a credit. I did not follow it because it has no authority. I relied only on the total the receipt records.
